name: Piranha Swarm
senses: blood scent, low-light vision, imprecise scent 100

traits.name: Blood Scent
traits.text: The piranha swarm can smell blood in the water from up to 1 mile away.

traits.name: Feeding Frenzy
traits.text: ⬻ Each enemy in the swarm's space takes 2d6 (2d6) piercing damage (DC 20 basic Reflex save). A creature that fails the save also takes 1d6 (1d6) persistent bleed damage and takes a –2 circumstance penalty to their Reflex saves against Feeding Frenzy while this damage continues, as the piranhas' frenzy increases in intensity when they smell blood.
